They played their home games at the [[Patrick Gym]] in [[Burlington, Vermont]] and were led by ninth-year head coach [[John Becker (basketball)|John Becker]]. They finished the season 26–7, 14–2 in America East play to win the reagular season conference championship. They defeated [[2019–20 Maine Black Bears men's basketball team|Maine]] and [[2019–20 UMBC Retrievers men's basketball team|UMBC]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2020 America East men's basketball tournament|America East tournament]]. However, the championship game, along with all other postseason tournaments, were cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Vermont Catamounts men's basketball team|Catamounts]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 27–7, 14–2 in conference play to finish in first place. In the [[2019 America East men's basketball tournament|America East tournament]], they defeated [[2018–19 Maine Black Bears men's basketball team|Maine]] in the quarterfinals,{{Cite news|url=https://uvmathletics.com/news/2019/3/9/mens-basketball-mens-hoops-advances-past-maine-73-57-in-america-east-quarterfinal.aspx?path=mbball|title=Men's Hoops Advances Past Maine 73-57 in America East Quarterfinal|work=University of Vermont Athletics|access-date=September 15, 2019|language=en}} [[2018–19 Binghamton Bearcats men's basketball team|Binghamton]] in the semifinals,{{Cite news|url=https://uvmathletics.com/news/2019/3/12/mens-basketball-smiths-record-setting-performance-pushes-cats-into-america-east-championship-game.aspx?path=mbball|title=Smith's Record-Setting Performance Pushes Cats into America East Championship Game|work=University of Vermont Athletics|access-date=September 15, 2019|language=en}} where they advanced to the championship game against [[2018–19 UMBC Retrievers men's basketball team|UMBC]], in which they won,{{Cite news|url=https://uvmathletics.com/news/2019/3/16/mens-basketball-mens-hoops-headed-back-to-big-dance-cats-knock-off-retrievers-66-49.aspx?path=mbball|title=Men's Hoops Headed Back to Big Dance; Cats Knock Off Retrievers 66-49|work=University of Vermont Athletics|access-date=September 15, 2019|language=en}} giving them the conference's automatic bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As the No. 13 seed in the West region, they lost to No. 4 [[2018–19 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] 76–69.{{cite
